_source: Select Group project page for The Torch, read 17 September 2026 (manifest: data/media/_sources/torch_tower.json).
_assets_from: 16 images published openly on that page. Unlike the off-plan buildings, these are PHOTOGRAPHS of a finished tower, not renders - the lobby shots are camera files (DSC....jpg) and the interiors are of built rooms. The image note says so.
_override_note: Roles from the developer's own filenames - 05-Torch-Living, 04-Torch-Bedroom, 08-Torch-Kitchen, 02-Torch-Pool. The hero is the tower seen from the street; the two files named -Views- are the view FROM the building (the marina, and the golf course inland), not pictures of it, so they are not used as the hero.
image_note: Images are published by Select Group, the developer of The Torch, on its own project page, and are reproduced here for a buyer considering the building. They are photographs of the completed building rather than computer renders, but they show show apartments and common areas — the finish of an individual unit may differ. Ask to view before relying on them.
caveats: Select Group publishes no apartment layouts for this building, so none are shown. Ask and we will request the plan for a specific unit.
